activities.label: Accelerate
activities.text: Action: up to 3 willing creatures within 20 feet. For 1 minute they can Dash as a bonus action; one making a Dexterity save can spend its reaction to end it and save with advantage. Once every 10 minutes per creature.

activities.label: Actualization Die: skill check

roll.note: Add it to a Deception, Insight, Perception or Persuasion check.

activities.text: Add the die to a Deception, Insight, Perception or Persuasion check.

castOptions.label: Actualization: −1 to targets' save per die
castOptions.note: Targets' saving throws −@amount.

rules.text: Genjutsu you cast may use Charisma in place of Wisdom (its effect: Charisma when it's higher). Illusion checks may use Charisma too: pick it when you roll. Actualization Dice: 1 + proficiency bonus per Long Rest (the pool). The cast dialog's options spend them: +rank d6 damage, or −1 to the targets' save per die (subtract it from each save). Mastery in Illusions at 1st, 7th and 13th comes from leveling up.
You understand and can communicate in any language or dialect, if the creature speaks a language.

activities.label: Enter Reality Shift
activities.text: Bonus action, 1 Actualization Die: the Reality Shift Amp for 1 minute (+1 Genjutsu save DC). 10 minutes before reuse.

rules.text: Reality Shift's AC: keep the Reality Shift: Genjutsu Save DC as AC item equipped (Equipment compendium, Class Items; Illusory): while the Amp is active, your AC is your Genjutsu save DC when that's higher. Your Genjutsu's saves can become Intelligence (at the table). It ends when you choose (no action) or are incapacitated.
Equip the Armor of Psychosis item (Equipment compendium, Class Items; Illusory, worn over armor): your AC uses your Genjutsu ability modifier in place of Dexterity.

castOptions.label: Battle Ready Minds: up to 4 willing creatures within 60 ft
castOptions.note: Bless targets up to 4 willing creatures up to 60 feet away.

rules.text: You can cast Animal Companion as a Bonus Action at no cost.

Bonus action: a Duplicity in an unoccupied space within 15 feet (the Class & Clan Summons NPC; its AC is your Genjutsu save DC). 1 minute, or until you dismiss it on your turn or are incapacitated. Up to 3, one commanded at a time. Displaced Genjutsu, Illusory Body, Illusory Distraction and Moving Illusion are on its sheet.
Creatures under a Genjutsu you cast or concentrate on take a 1d4 penalty to their attack rolls (subtract it in their dialog).

activities.label: Beguiling Presence: Invisible
activities.text: Creatures that failed a save against your Genjutsu can't see you until the end of your next turn (you're Invisible to them only).

castOptions.label: Beneath the Boot: 2 more targets
castOptions.note: Psionics: Crush! targets up to 2 more creatures.

castOptions.label: Berserk Thoughts: 15-ft radius
castOptions.note: Shadow Monsters affects every creature in a 15-foot radius on a point you can see in range.

activities.label: Betray your Friend
activities.text: Your Duplicity wears a hostile creature's appearance. Targeted by an attack or jutsu within 5 feet of that creature: the attacker or caster saves; on a failure it targets its ally instead.

rules.text: With 2 or more hostile creatures in initiative, they no longer treat allies who share the Duplicity's appearance as allies until it's dismissed.

activities.label: Betray Yourself
activities.text: 3 Actualization Dice: a creature under your Genjutsu whose appearance your Duplicity matches (Betray Your Friend). Failure: an Identity Crisis for 1 minute; it remakes the save at the end of each of its turns.

castOptions.label: Bewitching Whispers: you become the infatuation
castOptions.note: A Charmed hostile target: you can become the source of its infatuation, and its disposition toward you improves by 1 rank.

rules.text: Shadow Bite: +1 critical range (automatic). On a critical hit, the creature makes its save at disadvantage (roll it that way).

castOptions.label: Blade Song: concentration
castOptions.note: Damage can't break your concentration on Weapons of Darkness, and it needs no chakra to concentrate on.

castOptions.label: Blinding Lights: 10-ft cube within 60 ft
castOptions.note: Color Spray affects a 10-foot cube on a point within 60 feet (+5 feet a rank above D-Rank); otherwise it upcasts as normal.

activities.label: Book of Stolen Secrets
activities.text: In conversation, with a scroll or book in hand, ask one question. An unwilling creature saves; on a failure (or a truthful answer), the most accurate answer it could give appears in the book. Once per creature per hour.

castOptions.label: Broken Reality: Wisdom save
castOptions.note: The saving throw is Wisdom.

rules.text: In your Reality Shift, all your Genjutsu's saves can become Wisdom (the cast dialog option).

castOptions.label: Chained Mind: target within 10 ft
castOptions.note: Your attack has advantage (target within 10 feet). If it fails its save, you're Invisible to the Berserked creature.

activities.label: Chakra Disruption
activities.text: Once per turn: creatures that must save against your Genjutsu, or that your Genjutsu attack hits. Their next jutsu costs more (+2, +4 at 5th, +6 at 9th, +8 at 13th, +10 at 17th) until the end of their next turn.

roll.note: 9th level: a creature fails its save against your Genjutsu. It makes a Concentration check for the jutsu it concentrates on; if it already had to, it makes that check at disadvantage.

rules.text: Remove the cost increase after its next jutsu (one jutsu only).
Choose a Chakra Stance when you level up (Fighting Stances compendium).

activities.label: Cloak of Chains
activities.text: Bonus action, 1 Actualization Die: a 5-foot aura for 1 minute (not through cover, walls or barriers). A rank of Mastery with Intimidation against non-hostile creatures in it.

activities.label: Cloak of Chains: 4 psychic
activities.text: A hostile creature starting its turn in the aura.

activities.label: Mentally Compromised (1 minute)
activities.text: A creature that failed a save against your Genjutsu.

rules.text: Damage from a Genjutsu you cast or concentrate on: treat one of its damage dice as its highest value (set it on the damage card). Or, when a creature fails a save against your Genjutsu, it becomes Mentally Compromised for 1 minute (the button).
A remade save to end a Genjutsu you concentrate on can't have advantage.

activities.label: Corrupt Influence: Mentally Compromised
activities.text: A creature you touch.

rules.text: Mentally Compromised creatures can't spend their Actions to end hostile effects (such as Burned, Corroded or Bruised).

activities.label: Decelerate
activities.text: Action: 1 creature within 60 feet. Failure: 1 rank of Slow; it spends its Reaction to remake the save, ending it on a success. Once per creature every 10 minutes.

rules.text: Darkvision 120 feet, also through chakra-based darkness (its effect).

activities.label: Denial is a River (Touch)
activities.text: Rending Thoughts at Touch, outside combat. Success: it believes your next reasonably believable statement for 1 hour. Failure: it believes your next statement until challenged or 24 hours (challenged: it remakes the save, once per hour). Critical failure: permanently until challenged once by a new creature. Entering combat ends it.

castOptions.label: Devilish Recovery: hit points, not temporary (2 dice)
castOptions.note: The temporary hit points become hit points regained. Once per creature per hour.

rules.text: Mentally Compromised creatures suffer its enhanced effects (the 15-foot aura of madness on its condition card).

activities.label: Distracting Phantasm
activities.text: Reaction: a creature within 30 feet of your Phantasm attacks. Failure: it must target the Phantasm.

rules.text: A second Illusory Weapon (neither two-handed); summon both at once. Dual wielding them: their damage die is 1 step smaller, and your Attack action with them makes one more attack.

9th level. Action: a creature you've met within 100 miles (as casting a Genjutsu). You enter a trance as a messenger: aware but unable to act or move. If it's asleep, you appear in its dream, can converse and shape it; you can leave at any time. It recalls the dream on waking.

castOptions.label: Dulled Mind: 20-ft cube
castOptions.note: Slow affects creatures of your choice in a 20-foot cube on a point in range.

castOptions.label: Evil Thoughts: crit on 10 over AC
castOptions.note: An attack 10 or more over the target's AC is a critical hit (tick Critical on its damage).

rules.text: Your Genjutsu of D-Rank or lower (C-Rank at 6th, B-Rank at 14th) can't be identified except by special senses such as Chakra Sight or Chakra Sensing; in your Reality Shift, not even by those.

roll.note: Bonus action: an ally other than you gains an extra reaction. Not again for that creature until it finishes any rest.

rules.text: Choose a Fighting Style (Chapter 13); you can't take one more than once.

Action: touch a willing humanoid and perceive through its senses for 1 hour, within 1 mile; it ends if either of you takes damage. You use its special senses, and you're blinded and deafened to your own surroundings.
Choose your Genjutsu Inception when you level up (Hallucinatory Instrument, Illusory Weapon, Reality Marble or Temporal Stopwatch).
Choose your Genjutsu Pledge (subclass) when you level up: features at 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th and 18th.

castOptions.label: Ghastly Mist: 40-ft radius
castOptions.note: Fog of War's radius is 40 feet.

roll.note: Once on each of your turns, a Genjutsu attack hits: the target moves up to 10 feet straight toward you.

activities.label: Tune the Instrument
activities.text: Bonus action, for 1 minute: auditory Genjutsu without an attack roll can be Self (20-foot cone) or Self (10-foot radius sphere), affecting creatures of your choice that aren't deafened. 10 minutes before retuning.

roll.note: 11th level, Reaction: a hostile creature succeeds on a remade save. It remakes it with no bonuses and takes the new result.

rules.text: At 7th: Words of Affirmation or Words of Detriment (level-up choice).

castOptions.label: Haunting Melody: Shaken on a failure (instrument's area)
castOptions.note: Creatures that fail their save gain 1 rank of Shaken.

rules.text: Hallucinatory Instrument's area: auditory Genjutsu that deal damage give 1 rank of Shaken to creatures that fail (the cast dialog option).

Passive Genjutsu detection: 10 + your Illusions skill. A creature under a Genjutsu with a lower DC: you learn of it and its rank (once per turn in initiative). You're always aware of Genjutsu with the Unaware keyword affecting you.

castOptions.label: Illusionary Brawler: on yourself
castOptions.note: Targeting yourself: no chakra to concentrate. While it lasts, your unarmed attacks can be melee Genjutsu attacks.

roll.note: Casting a Genjutsu that inflicts a Mental Condition: +1 to the ranks it inflicts.

activities.label: Illusory Weapon (melee)
activities.text: Bonus action: summon it in your empty hand. Psychic damage, your Genjutsu attack bonus; always proficient.

activities.label: Illusory Weapon (ranged, 30 ft)
activities.text: Range 30 feet.

roll.note: 11th level, Reaction: a creature succeeds on a save against a jutsu you or an ally cast. Take the Attack action; if you hit at least once, it remakes the save and takes the new result.

rules.text: Dismissed at no action or when you're incapacitated. Counts as a weapon for class features, and as the W component of D-Rank Bukijutsu (C-Rank at 7th, B-Rank at 15th). At 7th, the Attack action with it attacks twice (Attack action count at the table).
Advantage on History checks (automatic). Creating or learning Genjutsu takes half the downtime.

roll.note: Reaction: a creature under at least 1 of your Genjutsu takes an action you can see. End the Genjutsu you concentrate on to interrupt its action (an Elite Action: it loses only that).

castOptions.label: Maddening Pain: allies trigger it
castOptions.note: Its bonus damage triggers from your allies' attacks too, once per turn per creature.

castOptions.label: Magnum Opus: choose who it affects
castOptions.note: You choose which creatures are affected.

rules.text: Two Mirages at 2nd; one more at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 20th (level-up choices). When you gain one, you can swap a known Mirage for another.

One choice at 9th (Higher Understanding: creatures must beat your save DC by 8 to critically succeed; or Genjutsu Flow: +30 feet range, Touch and 5-foot Genjutsu reach 30 feet) and one at 15th (New Reality: saves against your Genjutsu can't have advantage; or Greater Mastery: a save 4 or more under your DC is a critical failure). Apply the degrees at the table.

roll.note: Once per turn, in your Reality Shift: a creature failed the first save of a C-Rank or lower Genjutsu you concentrate on. Swap in another C-Rank or lower concentration Genjutsu you know: no save; its failure effects apply for the remaining duration, replacing any mental conditions with its own.

activities.label: Regain 1 Actualization Die

roll.note: Once per round, on succeeding a save against a hostile creature.

activities.text: Once per round (before your turn starts): you succeed on a save against a hostile creature.

rules.text: On a Short Rest you regain 2 Actualization Dice (3 at 11th, 4 at 17th): automatic.

activities.label: Miasmic Brand: 2d6 poison
activities.text: An ally branded by starting or entering your Phantom Cloud on its turn: its [Weapon Damage] and [Unarmed Damage] deal 2d6 more poison, up to twice per turn, until the end of its turn. Against a creature with Psychosis, it also suffers Neurotoxic Feedback.

activities.label: Rending Thoughts as a Bonus action

roll.note: Use Rending Thoughts as a Bonus action (not also as an Action that turn).

activities.label: Mind Leech: target's saves
activities.text: 1 Actualization Die with Rending Thoughts, on a failure or critical failure: −1 to its Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves until the end of your next turn (−2 at 14th, −3 at 18th).

activities.label: Mind Leech: your saves (critical failure)
activities.text: On its critical failure: you gain the same bonus to your Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves.

rules.text: Corrupt Thoughts' Mentally Compromised is in the Conditions compendium (Genjutsu Specialist).

castOptions.label: Mind Over Matter (with Actualization)
castOptions.note: Only when you use an Actualization effect on this Genjutsu.

rules.text: With an Actualization effect on a Genjutsu that doesn't already add your Genjutsu modifier to its damage: + your Genjutsu modifier psychic damage (the cast dialog option).

castOptions.label: Misty Thoughts: a non-hostile target (no chakra)
castOptions.note: No Hand Sign component; on a non-hostile creature it costs no chakra (not on a hostile one).

castOptions.label: Misty Visions: only physical inspection
castOptions.note: It can only be dispelled by physical inspection.

activities.label: Muddled Movements
activities.text: A Genjutsu attack hits: the target's speed is 10 feet lower until the end of your next turn.

castOptions.label: Myriad Forms: an object
castOptions.note: Small, medium or large objects. Large: your weight and space don't change (you only look larger); an Investigation or Illusions check against your Genjutsu save DC reveals it. Small: you fit smaller spaces but can't move from where you transformed (a willing carrier can move you).

activities.label: Neurotoxic Feedback
activities.text: Reaction: a creature in your Phantom Cloud takes chakra damage, has a jutsu's cost raised by a hostile effect, or makes a Chakra Control check. Failure: the damage, and one effect until the end of your next turn: Blinded, half speed, or −2 to Constitution saves.

activities.label: Nightmare Incarnate
activities.text: Psychic damage from your Genjutsu: the next attack against it before the start of your next turn has +1 to hit and +1 critical range.

roll.note: Action, in dim light or darkness: you become Invisible (turn on the status) and make no sound moving. It ends if you move more than half your speed in a round, attack or cast a jutsu.

activities.label: Recharge a Phantasm ability

roll.note: One of its Recharge abilities is ready again.

activities.text: 1 Actualization Die: one of its Recharge abilities is ready again.

rules.text: Action: summon your Phantasm (the Class & Clan Summons NPC: AC 20, 10 HP; its attacks use your Genjutsu attack bonus and its saves your Genjutsu save DC). Command it as a Bonus action. One at a time (two from Phantasmic Double); it's dispelled more than 120 feet from you. Small, always tinged black.

activities.label: Thought Bomb
activities.text: Your Phantasm (Recharge 9-10 or 1 minute): creatures of your choice within 15 feet of a point it occupies, with the effects of the infused Genjutsu (C-Rank or lower, inflicting a Mental Condition; choose it after any rest).

rules.text: A second Phantasm: summon both with the same action, and command both with one Bonus action.

roll.note: Reaction, taking damage: you and your Phantasm swap places (within 20 feet of each other).

rules.text: Your Phantasm can be Small or Medium and gains a fly speed equal to its speed. Once per turn it can cast one of your Genjutsu of D-Rank or lower (C-Rank at 10th, B-Rank at 14th) with your statistics at one creature only; you pay the chakra.
Your Phantasms act during your turn without a Bonus action command and can be up to 1 mile away; when one is dispelled, you gain what it saw and heard.

activities.label: Phantom Bloom: −2 AC
activities.text: Hostile creatures starting their turn in or first entering your Phantom Cloud: −2 AC until they end a turn outside it.

rules.text: Your Phantom Clouds grow 5 feet in every direction at the start of each of your turns, up to a 40-foot cube.

activities.label: Throw a Phantom Vapor vial

roll.note: A thin cloud at a point within 30 ft (see the text).

activities.text: Bonus action: a 10-foot cube within 30 feet for 1 minute (one cloud at a time). Your Genjutsu targeting a creature inside gain the Inhaled keyword. 10th: 1 more charge for a 20-foot cube; 18th: 2 more charges to heavily obscure it and block Chakra Sight and Chakra Sensing.

activities.label: Recharge with 1 Actualization Die

roll.note: Spend 1 Actualization Die (or 10 minutes) to regain a charge.

activities.text: Spend 1 Actualization Die (or 10 minutes of work) to regain a charge.

rules.text: Alchemist Kit proficiency (or a rank of Mastery if already proficient). After any rest, turn a Poison or Alchemist kit into your Phantom Vapors Kit: 1 + proficiency bonus charges (the pool, refilled on any rest).

castOptions.label: Piece of Mind: as a Bonus Action (d8 damage)
castOptions.note: Cast as a Bonus Action; its damage die becomes a d8 (change it on the damage roll).

castOptions.label: Prolonged Songs: Self (40-ft cone)
castOptions.note: Its range can be Self (40-foot cone).

activities.label: Psyche Drinker

roll.note: Gain the damage dealt as temporary HP until the end of your next turn (once per turn).

activities.text: Once per turn, dealing damage with a Genjutsu: gain the damage dealt as temporary hit points until the end of your next turn (add them on the sheet).

rules.text: Your Genjutsu of D-Rank or lower (C-Rank at 10th, B-Rank at 14th) gain the Unaware keyword.

activities.label: Awaken the Reality Marble
activities.text: Bonus action, for 1 minute: each Genjutsu you cast stores a Reality Mote. Spend one when casting to mark the target as a reality relay: Genjutsu targeting it can pick up to 2 more creatures within 30 feet of it, which save as if the target; the mark then ends; failing creatures share the worst result. Once per creature every 10 minutes; 10 minutes before reawakening.

roll.note: 11th level: a creature marked as your relay passes a save. It remakes it and takes the new result.

rules.text: At 7th, Genjutsu you concentrate on cost 2 less to concentrate (minimum 1).

activities.label: Relentless Pain

roll.note: Deal psychic damage equal to the damage you took.

activities.text: Reaction, taking damage within 60 feet of your Doubled Pain target, which can see you: deal it psychic damage equal to the damage you took.

activities.label: Rending Thoughts
activities.text: Action: a creature you can see within 60 feet (a Genjutsu of your highest rank; Auditory or Visual, and Tactile). Success: the success damage. Failure: the failure damage and a penalty to its next attack roll before your next turn. Critical failure: the critical damage.

activities.label: Rending Thoughts: failure
activities.text: Also a 1d4 penalty to its next attack roll before your next turn.

roll.note: On a failure: subtract this from its next attack roll before the beginning of your next turn.

rules.text: Damage +1d6 at 6th, 10th and 14th; the penalty die grows a step at each (1d6, 1d8, 1d10).

roll.note: A Genjutsu attack hits: push the target up to 10 feet away from you in a straight line.
Once per turn, Reaction: you'd fail a Strength or Dexterity save or be hit by an attack. Remake the save, or the attacker rerolls, taking the second result.

rules.text: When you cast the Darkness ninjutsu, it gains the Genjutsu and Visual keywords.

castOptions.label: Signature Work: the illusion casts a Genjutsu
castOptions.note: Choose a C-Rank or lower Genjutsu you know: the illusion can cast it once per minute (your Genjutsu attack and DC, your level). Damaged as if real, it's dispelled. Once per Long Rest.

rules.text: In your Reality Shift: concentrate on up to 3 Genjutsu at a time (at the table).

roll.note: After casting: you gain 3 ranks of the Confused and Concussed conditions (add them).

rules.text: 15th level. Once per Long Rest: an S-Rank Genjutsu you qualify for as a Full-Turn Action at no cost (pick zero cost in the cast dialog). After that, cast it for 4 Chakra Dice.

activities.label: Shift initiative

roll.note: Raise or lower one creature's initiative by the roll (once per initiative).

activities.text: Rolling initiative: one creature you can see; raise or lower its initiative by the roll (once per initiative).

activities.label: Wind the Stopwatch
activities.text: Bonus action, for 1 minute: once per turn, a Genjutsu you cast also gives you the Dash or Disengage action after its effect.

roll.note: 11th level, Reaction: a hostile creature under a jutsu you or an ally cast attacks or casts. Until the start of its next turn, it can't remake saves at the end of its turn.

rules.text: At 7th: Rewind or Fast Forward (level-up choice).
Reaction, failing a save against a Genjutsu: cast Release.

castOptions.label: The First, Second and Third: merge Genjutsu (1–2 dice)
castOptions.note: Merged with @amount more Genjutsu of the same rank that deal no damage: add their base costs; on a failed save the target also suffers them.

rules.text: Merge Genjutsu: the cast dialog option spends 1 or 2 Actualization Dice; add the other Genjutsu's base cost and apply its effects on a failed save.

roll.note: Once per turn, a Genjutsu forces saves: every affected creature's result is 1 step worse (critical success to success, failure to critical failure).

rules.text: Your Genjutsu can't be dispelled or Interrupted.

roll.note: A vial of basic poison becomes a poison of D-Rank or lower (C-Rank at 10th, B-Rank at 18th) from the Shinobi Handbook list, for 1 hour or until used.

castOptions.label: Tree Binding Death: up to 3 targets
castOptions.note: Up to 3 targets. Then 10 minutes of rest before you use it again.

roll.note: Action, 2 or more Duplicities: you vanish and occupy all their spaces until the end of the turn. Move As One (all your movement: move them all) and Act As One (Bonus action: each casts a Genjutsu of D-Rank or lower at a different creature; you pay only the highest cost). At the end of the turn, dismiss one and teleport to its space.

castOptions.label: Vampiric Pain: chakra damage too
castOptions.note: When the creature takes damage, it also takes chakra damage equal to the psychic damage Doubled Pain deals.

activities.label: Coat a weapon in poison

roll.note: Its damage becomes poison; Phantom Weapon and Hallucinatory Flurry are available.

activities.text: 1 Phantom Vapor Charge: a simple weapon's damage becomes poison, and Phantom Weapon and Hallucinatory Flurry become available (each an Action; either removes the coat).

roll.note: Action, coated weapon: cast a Bukijutsu you know; it gains the Genjutsu and Inhaled keywords. Removes the coat.

Action, coated weapon: a Genjutsu of C-Rank or lower with a 1-Action casting time, as a melee or ranged Genjutsu attack with the weapon. Hit: [Weapons Damage] and the Genjutsu's effect on that creature only. Removes the coat.

rules.text: Simple weapons with the Thrown property use your Genjutsu attack bonus and Genjutsu ability modifier for damage (at the table).

roll.note: Action, coated weapon: two melee or ranged Genjutsu attacks (one ammunition die roll). Each deals [Weapons Damage]; one or more hits: Psychosis. Removes the coat.

activities.label: Nightmare Rain
activities.text: Action, coated weapon: creatures of your choice in a Phantom Cloud within 90 feet. Failure: the chakra damage and Psychosis; success: half and no Psychosis. Removes the coat.

rules.text: These are Genjutsu of your highest rank with the Inhale keyword.

Coated weapons' damage die is 2 steps larger (up to d12). Phantom Weapon takes up to B-Rank Genjutsu and can repeat the attack on a second creature in range. Venom Chain and Nightmare Rain can be Bonus actions.
Rending Thoughts affects every creature of your choice in a 10-foot radius on a point in range.
Telepathy with 2 willing creatures up to 1 mile away (3 at 7th, 4 at 18th); you must know their general location, and they can resist it.

roll.note: Reaction, an attack would damage you while your Duplicity is active: swap places with it; the attack hits the Duplicity.

activities.label: Words of Affirmation
activities.text: Action: creatures of your choice within 10 feet gain these temporary hit points. Others can't gain them more than twice per initiative.

activities.label: Words of Detriment
activities.text: Action: creatures of your choice in a 20-foot cone remake saves to end effects at the end of their next turn at disadvantage.
